name: hardcoded record ids override another system's data
description: The diff forces three membership-term ids active instead of fixing the terms where they live. The reviewer rated it an unverified medium; the override rule makes it a verified defect that holds the merge.

model_output.summary: Adds a list of term ids that are always shown.

findings.title: Term ids forced visible
findings.body: ALWAYS_VISIBLE = ['T-101', 'T-102', 'T-103'] works around the booking system's data.

live_review.title: Show the spring terms on the website
live_review.body: Members can't book the spring terms online: the booking system has them marked as not available on the web, which is wrong. This forces them visible.
